# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large gaps up often fail to hold above VWAP; an early close below VWAP on high volume predicts a fade back to VWAP. This strategy fades the gap when VWAP acts as a magnet and early volume shows rejection, differing from GAP_AND_GO which trades gap continuation.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: IF (today's open > prior close × 1.004) AND (open price > VWAP) AND (the first 5‑min bar close < VWAP) AND (volume of that bar > 1.5 × 20‑period average volume) THEN go short at the close of that bar.  
Exit shape: Chart‑stop at prior day's high (structure invalidation), TP1 at VWAP, runner trail 10% off HWM.  
Regime hint: VIX < 22 (low‑moderate volatility), time 09:30‑10:00 EST.
